description: Synthetic Animal Burrow Dataset for Levee Monitoring is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Padam Jung Thapa, Md Tamjidul Hoque. "This dataset, titled \"Synthetic Animal Burrow Dataset for Levee Monitoring: Generated Using DreamBooth Diffusion Models,\" presents a rich collection of synthetic images created to support the study and development of semantic segmentation models for detecting animal burrows in levee systems. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
